items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: these things came from Charlie Howze's collection... Charlie Howze brought up when we had the dedication on the House that Jazz Built.

ctx.x: That's right. I have a feeling -- I heard somewhere that the Jazz Institute was negotiating to get custody of some of those tapes from the radio station. I don't know if that's true or not.

That would really be great because he really contributed a great deal to the, as you said, the conscience of the jazz community, those who knew and those who didn't know jazz. We have these Black and White albums. As I said, these things came from Charlie Howze's collection and he has some things on this Black and White label, one is --
Yeah, some are with a group called the Village Cats.
